title: The surprise party
grammar: want to / would like to (plans and wishes)

scene.speaker: erik
scene.bubble: Top secret: Sofía's birthday is on Friday. We want to prepare the BEST surprise party in club history!
scene.intro: Top secret! Sofía's birthday is on Friday, and the Club wants to prepare a surprise. Valentina would like to make the cake, Erik wants to invent something that throws balloons, and Mateo wants to invite everybody — quietly. What do YOU want to do at the weekend? Make a plan!

data.voice_note: Voces: Erik (susurrando el plan) y Valentina (lista en mano).
data.script: Erik: Secret meeting! The party is going to be on Friday at five. … Valentina: I'm going to write twelve invitations tonight. … Erik: My confetti machine is going to shoot confetti for one minute! … Valentina: Grandma would like to bake a chocolate cake with strawberries. … Erik: And Mateo? … Valentina: He's going to blow up thirty balloons. Green and gold. … Erik: Luna's mission: to walk with Sofia in the park until five. … Valentina: This is going to be the best surprise ever!
